title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 16: the collection for the saints, travel plans through Macedonia, and the closing greetings written by Paul's own hand.

questions.text: Which assemblies had already been given the same command about the collection for the saints?
questions.explanation: The text says: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

questions.text: On which day were they each to save, as they might prosper?
questions.explanation: They were told that on the first day of every week each one should save, as he may prosper, so that no collections would be made when the writer came.

answers.text: On the first day of every week
On the last day of every month

questions.text: Where was the gracious gift to be carried?
questions.explanation: The writer says that when he arrives he will send whoever they approve, with letters, to carry their gracious gift to Jerusalem.

questions.text: Where does the writer say he will stay until Pentecost?
questions.explanation: He says he will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost, because a great and effective door has opened to him and there are many adversaries.

questions.text: What were they to do if Timothy came to them?
questions.explanation: They were to see that Timothy was with them without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, and to let no one despise him.

answers.text: See that he is with them without fear, and let no one despise him
Send him straight on to Galatia with the gift
Ask him to write a letter of commendation

questions.text: What does the text say about Apollos coming to them at that time?
questions.explanation: The writer strongly urged Apollos to come with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; he will come when he has an opportunity.

answers.text: He was already on his way to them together with the brothers
He refused ever to come to Corinth or to write to them
It was not his desire to come now, but he will come when he has an opportunity
He was told to stay at Ephesus until Pentecost had come

questions.text: According to verse 14, how should all that they do be done?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says: Let all that you do be done in love.

questions.text: What does the text say about the house of Stephanas?
questions.explanation: The text says they know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints.

answers.text: That it was the richest house in all of Corinth
That it had been baptized by Apollos and the brothers
That it had written the letter of commendation for him
That it is the first fruits of Achaia and has set itself to serve the saints

questions.text: At whose coming does the writer say he rejoices, because they supplied what was lacking?
questions.explanation: He rejoices at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus, for they supplied that which was lacking on the Corinthians' part and refreshed his spirit.

questions.text: Which couple greets them much in the Lord, together with the assembly in their house?
questions.explanation: The text says Aquila and Priscilla greet them much in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
